messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex for The New Boar?
messages.body:
Hi,

Just gently chasing my earlier note on Jake Essex.

He's from Essex, own PA, no deposit, from £300 for two one hour sets, or £250 a night when you book four. Saturday nights in 2027. He's free Sat 12 June, Sat 2 October and Sat 27 November 2027, from 8pm. If a date works, just reply here and I'll lock it in.

Natalie
Bookings for Jake Essex
